---
title: "Security & Secrets"
---

Using coding agents involves granting them the ability to execute code on your machine. This introduces several security and integrity risks that must be managed.

## Common Risks

### Unsafe Code Execution
An agent might generate code that deletes files or opens network vulnerabilities. Always use the **human-in-the-loop** pattern to review commands.

### Data Leakage
Agents might send sensitive data (API keys, credentials) to the LLM provider. This is why we use safeguards like hooks and plugins.

## Mitigating Data Leakage

To prevent the agent from reading sensitive files (like `.env` files), we use:
- **OpenCode:** [Env Protection Plugins](https://opencode.ai/docs/plugins/#env-protection).
- **Gemini CLI:** Hooks to block access to specific files.
